summary: Audit a base GLB against its PACE file, fix missing or incorrect elements (placement, cameras, focal length, trajectory animations), and emit a corrected GLB plus a Markdown review report.

inputs.base_glb.assetUri.description: assets:// URI of the base GLB to audit and fix. Parsed worker-side into a node/camera/animation inventory and embedded (base64) into the fix script for runtime re-import.

pace_document.description: PACE 0.2 document used as ground truth for the audit (same shape as blender-pace-3d): scenes[].physical_layout (subjects/props by ref+world_xy+z+facing_deg, camera_setups by shot_id+world_xy+z+looking_at+lens_mm, focus_points) and shots[].camera.trajectory.

output.review_report: Markdown report: issues found, fixed, unfixable, before/after (pace_review_report.md).

pipeline: download base GLB → inspect → agent audit (report + fix script) → import base GLB + run fix in Blender → re-export corrected GLB.
